result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The wide asphalt area and lack of modern traffic calming measures suggest a priority for vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide intersection geometry
hazards.description: The large open asphalt area and wide corner radii may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the roadway surface can create uneven footing for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed and clearly visible to all crossing directions.

result.summary: The environment is a high-capacity, multi-lane boulevard with a very wide crossing distance that prioritizes vehicle throughput. While a marked crosswalk and a wide grassy median refuge are present, the scale of the roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide multi-lane roadway, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main boulevard

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and lack of traffic calming suggest high vehicle speeds, which increase the risk of severe injury in a collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes of the boulevard

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Hardened Median Refuge
interventions.description: Upgrade the grassy median with paved waiting areas and detectable warning surfaces to provide a safer mid-point stop.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with a high-visibility marked crosswalk and curb ramps. However, the crossing distance is significant, and there are no visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands to protect people crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross the wide intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to inform pedestrians of remaining crossing time and improve predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed arterial intersection with residential land use. While a high-visibility crosswalk and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distances and lack of visible pedestrian signals create a car-centric environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk spans a wide intersection area without any intermediate refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, the white continental crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light poles on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Prohibitive Signage
hazards.description: A 'No Cross Over' sign indicates a lack of legal crossing opportunities across the main arterial, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: On the grass median to the left of the main roadway.
